incumbent_comparison: Compared directly to workarea-v003 using matched run-003/run-001 production cameras. v005 restores the missing v2 equipment details after footprint correction: tools, pegs, organized bins, side storage, and a drive wheel. It keeps the open yard, does not lower any required rubric score, and resolves the specific sparse-yard defect.
next_action_hypothesis: Promote workarea-v005 as the stable assembly-yard visual while preserving the live activity site and construction stage logic.

observations.art_direction_fit: The mix of timber equipment, stone pavers, and exposed clockwork matches the miniature steampunk setting and reads as functional yard equipment.
observations.close_up_quality: The run-001 asset-detail capture resolves the hanging implements, pegs, gear teeth, lathe spindle, storage bins, and trestle shoes; these give the close view concrete workshop detail.
observations.gameplay_readability: The candidate remains open around the activity bench; the mesh is presentation-only and the normal production scene retains construction-stage ownership.
observations.geometric_detail: The same run-001 close/three-quarter images show hanging tools, pegs, side shelf, bins, drive wheel, spindle, pavers, and joined trestles as separate details.
observations.material_realism: Wood, stone, iron, and brass remain visibly distinct under the production light, with metal fittings catching small highlights rather than appearing uniformly matte.
observations.proportion: Godot reports 23 x 9 x 12 inches, matching the brief envelope; the elevated workbench is visually proportionate to the miniature agents.
observations.scale_fidelity: The validation report matches the intended 23 x 9 x 12 inch bounds; the scene capture shows the bench above the live half-inch citizen scale.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The run-001 settlement and asset views now read as an equipped clockwork assembly yard with a hoist, workbench, gears, lathe spindle, and organized storage.
observations.silhouette_quality: The gantry and two trestles establish a readable open-yard silhouette; the new right-side bench/storage does not close the central work area.
observations.surface_variation: Alternating paving blocks, varied bin tones, dark iron, and brass gears break up the large bench and yard surfaces in the production close view.
